sermon.title: Where do Some Civil Rulers Get Their Authority to Judge? — September 6, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer asks where rulers get authority to make harmful judgments: from above, as Jesus told Pilate. In Judges 19–20 Israel bypassed God’s judicial system after the Gibeah atrocity and lost twice, then won after weeping, fasting and offerings. The American church has lost its fight and fire and must repent and stand.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore by Him let us continually offer the sacrifice of praise to God, that is, the fruit of our lips, giving thanks to His name.

faqs.question: Why study the Old Testament?
faqs.answer: Romans 15:4: whatever was written before was written for our learning.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, does not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

faqs.question: God’s army?
faqs.answer: He does according to His will.

scriptures.text_nkjv: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; He does according to His will in the army of heaven And among the inhabitants of the earth. No one can restrain His hand Or say to Him, “What have You done?”
